# ngrok documentation: Pricing

> Every page in the Pricing section of the ngrok docs (4 pages). Each link points to the page's Markdown version.

## Pricing

- [Pricing and Limits](https://ngrok.com/docs/pricing-limits/index.md): Compare what each paid ngrok plan includes, check add-on and wildcard endpoint pricing, and find out how to view your current usage.
- [Free Plan Limits](https://ngrok.com/docs/pricing-limits/free-plan-limits.md): Learn about the limits and restrictions enforced on the free ngrok for developers plan including endpoint limits and usage quotas.
- [Traffic Policy Unit (TPU) Pricing](https://ngrok.com/docs/pricing-limits/traffic-policy-unit-pricing.md): Each Traffic Policy action and variable has its own TPU cost, and many are free. Pay-as-you-go plans get a lower TPU price at higher volumes.
- [Pricing Glossary](https://ngrok.com/docs/pricing-limits/pricing-glossary.md): Look up what each feature and usage metric in the ngrok pricing docs means, such as online endpoints, endpoint hours, and load balancing.
